text: So, in dimensional units, these are watts, these are seconds, and this is joule. Okay. Now, if the energy level of energy that we measure is greater than a threshold given by the energy that we normally sense when there is only noise, then we say that on the channel there is a signal, one more signals, right? Because the level of power that this antenna is receiving is sensing is greater than what you usually see when there is only noise. So you say that the channel is busy because you don't know who, but there are signals. Someone is sending signals on the channel. So if this sensed measured level of energy is greater than this threshold, the value of energy that you normally have on the channel when there is only noise, you say channel busy. If instead this level of energy is less than or equal to this threshold, what you say when there is just noise, I cannot hear much energy, so what I sense is just noise.
